description: Start a profiling run for a model on the AITune sidecar: pass model, and optionally batch_sizes, measurement_steps, saturation_cutoff and include_warmup to override the defaults. It uses GPU time on the sidecar; read the finished report with get_aitune_profiling. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

include_warmup.description: Include the warm-up run in the report.

measurement_steps.description: How many steps to measure at each batch size.

saturation_cutoff.description: Stop growing the batch once throughput gains fall below this.

name: start_aitune_profiling
